limitations: The package is executable from a clean clone but not relocatable: the factory computes PO03_ROOT from Path(__file__).parents[1], so running the staged copy in place resolved the control tree to attempts/po03-wa-b2e7-062-g1-packaging/control/tasks/... and printed INVALID: missing input.json/acceptance.json/transaction-created.json and 'no events'. Both arms are recorded in clean-clone-report.json; only the deployed arm reads the ledger, so whoever ingests this package into successor/g1/ must preserve the workstreams/po03/tools/ layout or the package will silently look for custody state in the wrong place. The package also does not vendor its runtime dependencies (validate_contracts.py and the two contract schemas are named with digests but read from the repository at runtime), so it is not self-contained. G1 was measured on a producer-authored public suite; independence for its six failures rests on the sealed evaluator-held holdout from unit 059, whose seal was frozen before this measurement. The clone was taken from the local linked worktree rather than fetched from the network, though its HEAD was confirmed equal to the pushed origin sha.
